item.text: {"summary":"Fix placeholder digit-to-argument indexing in SubstituteAndAppendArray.","explanation":"The assertions show the same failure across five test groups: for example, Substitute(\"$0, $1!\", \"Hello\", \"world\") returns \"\" instead of \"Hello, world!\", while SubstituteAndAppend leaves str as \"Hello\" instead of \"Hello, world!\". The vector<bool> and enum assertions also expect values inserted for $0 and subsequent placeholders but receive empty output; the AbslStringifyWithEnum assertion expects \"Choices\" but gets \"\". In both the sizing pass and the output-building pass, the implementation subtracts '1' from the placeholder digit. That makes $0 produce index -1 and causes the sizing pass to return without appending; other placeholders also select the preceding argument. Subtracting '0' maps $0 through $9 to indices 0 through 9 consistently in both passes.","edits":[{"path":"absl/strings/substitute.cc","old":"int index = format[i + 1] - '1';","new":"int index = format[i + 1] - '0';"},{"path":"absl/strings/substitute.cc","old":"args_array[format[i + 1] - '1']","new":"args_array[format[i + 1] - '0']"}]}
